title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Why isn’t Payment Tolerance being taken automatically in the Cash Receipt Journal?
summary: Payment Tolerance in Business Central can automatically write off small remaining invoice balances when a payment is applied. The post shows that tolerance is only taken when the Cash Receipt Journal line has Document Type set to Payment; otherwise no tolerance warning appears and no tolerance GL entry posts.
key_points: Payment tolerance settings are configured in General Ledger Setup using a percentage of invoice value with a maximum limit
Cash receipt journal entries must have Payment as the document type for payment tolerance to apply automatically
When correctly applied, an extra GL entry posts to the payment tolerance account
Entering a cash receipt without selecting Payment as document type prevents the tolerance warning and GL posting
